title: Weight Scale Rebalancing: Transferable Training Recipes for Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.32866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training Transformers requires careful hyperparameter tuning, which becomes increasingly costly for large models. We introduce UDV-Rebalance (UDVR), a reparameterization that inserts an auxiliary diagonal matrix $D$ between naturally paired weight matrices $(U,V)$ appearing throughout Transformer architectures. UDVR periodically rebalances the factors to maintain unit-norm columns in $U$ and unit-norm rows in $V$, with $D$ absorbing the corresponding scales. With rebalancing, a single hyperparameter setting of UDVR remains effective across model scales, architectures, and data distributions. This yields a tuning-free rule that adapts to each weight matrix using only its dimensions. We fit this rule once on ViT models trained on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and it remains valid when the activation function or the optimizer is changed. translated_title: 权重尺度再平衡：可迁移的Transformer训练配方
translated_abstract: 训练Transformer需要细致的超参数调优，而这对大型模型来说成本越来越高。我们提出了UDV-Rebalance（UDVR），这是一种重参数化方法，在Transformer架构中自然成对出现的权重矩阵(U,V)之间插入一个辅助对角矩阵D。UDVR周期性地重新平衡这些因子，使U保持单位范数的列、V保持单位范数的行，而相应的尺度由D吸收。通过再平衡，UDVR的单一超参数设置在模型规模、架构和数据分布之间均保持有效。这产生了一条免调优规则，仅需利用每个权重矩阵自身的维度即可对其进行适配。我们在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上训练的ViT模型上对该规则拟合了一次，即使更换激活函数或优化器，该规则仍然有效。同样的规则可迁移到DomainNet中的新图像域、ImageNet上的ViT、Swin和MaxViT，以及语言（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出UDVR重参数化方法，在Transformer成对权重矩阵间插入辅助对角矩阵并周期性再平衡尺度，得到一条仅需矩阵维度的免调优超参数规则，可跨模型规模、架构、优化器和数据分布直接迁移。
en_tdlr: UDVR reparameterization inserts an auxiliary diagonal matrix between paired weight matrices and periodically rebalances their scales, yielding a tuning-free hyperparameter rule that transfers across model scales, architectures, optimizers, and data distributions.
